checks.text: With no goals, the page shows the heading "Savings Goal Tracker", the text "No goals yet", and the button "New goal".

Clicking "New goal" opens a form. Filling the field labelled "Goal name" with "Emergency Fund", the field labelled "Target amount" with "5000", choosing "2025-12-31" in the date picker labelled "Deadline", and clicking "Save goal" adds a list item containing "Emergency Fund", "$0.00 / $5,000.00", and "0%". The text "No goals yet" is gone.

Clicking the "Add deposit" button on the "Emergency Fund" list item opens a form. Filling the field labelled "Amount" with "250.75" and clicking "Save deposit" updates the list item to show "$250.75 / $5,000.00" and "5%".
After adding a second goal "Vacation" with target "2000" and deadline "2025-08-15", and adding a deposit of "1000" to it, the "Vacation" list item shows "$1,000.00 / $2,000.00" and "50%".
Clicking the "Delete goal" button on the "Vacation" list item removes that item from the list. The "Emergency Fund" item remains with "$250.75 / $5,000.00".
Clicking the "Progress" tab shows a view with a circular progress ring for each goal. For "Emergency Fund" with $250.75 saved of $5,000.00, the ring displays "5%" and the text "Emergency Fund".

Clicking the "History" tab shows a table with columns "Date", "Goal", "Amount", and "Running Total". After adding a deposit of "250.75" to "Emergency Fund" on 2024-01-15, the table shows a row with "2024-01-15", "Emergency Fund", "$250.75", and "$250.75".
Clicking the "Export CSV" button copies a CSV string to the clipboard. The clipboard contains "Goal,Target,Saved,Percent\nEmergency Fund,5000.00,250.75,5".
Reload keeps the goal "Emergency Fund" with its deposit. After reloading, the list shows "Emergency Fund", "$250.75 / $5,000.00", and "5%".
